Parameter.Folded: States whether this panel is folded (TRUE) or unfolded (everything else) when it is loaded (defaults to TRUE).
Parameter.CSSHeaderHover: The optional header's CSS:hover (defaults to { scale : 1.1 ;}).
Parameter.CSSHeaderActive: The optional header's CSS:active (defaults to { scale : .9 ;}).
Parameter.CSSHeaderFolded: The optional CSS to be applied onto the header when the panel is FOLDED. Without it a panel that is (or starts) folded would lose the header look set via CSSHeaderUnfolded.
Parameter.CSSHeaderUnfolded: The optional CSS to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded.
Parameter.DCSSHeaderUnfolded: The optional Darkmode CSS to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded.
Parameter.CSSAnimFadeINPanel: The optional animation to be applied onto the panel whenever the panel is unfolded.
Parameter.CSSAnimFadeINPanelDuration: The optional animation's duration that is applied onto the panel whenever the panel is unfolded (defaults to 0s).
Parameter.CSSAnimFadeINPanelEasing: The optional animation's easing function that is applied onto the panel whenever the panel is unfolded (defaults to "ease-in-out").
Parameter.CSSAfterHeader: The CSS:after to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded.
Parameter.CSSBeforeHeader: The CSS:before to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded (will be overwritten when required fields are contained by the panel).
Parameter.CSSAfterHeaderContent: The CSS:after content to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded.
Parameter.CSSBeforeHeaderContent: The CSS:before content to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded (will be overwritten when required fields are contained by the panel).
Parameter.CSSAfterHeaderContentUnfolded: The CSS:after content to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded.
Parameter.CSSBeforeHeaderContentUnfolded: The CSS:after content to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded (will be overwritten when required fields are contained by the panel).
Parameter.CSSRequiredFieldsContent: The CSS:before content to be applied onto the header if it contains a validation sensitive field.
Parameter.CSSRequiredFields: The CSS:before to be applied onto the header if it contains a validation sensitive field.
Parameter.AutoHeaderTitle: The string the automatically generated header shall display.
Parameter.AutoHeaderTitleSupplementsSpacer: The string separating the actual title from the strings that're supplemented (values of inputs tagged with the CSS-Class CodBi_HTML_Panel_AutoHeaderTitle_Supplement). Encode surrounding spaces as %20 or \s.
Parameter.AutoHeaderLevel: Which level of enclosing heading the AutoHeaderTitle shall have, e.g. to get a h1 enclosure the value has to be 1.
Parameter.ScrollBlock: Defines the logical position to scroll to when the panel is unfolded (start, center, end, nearest). Defaults to "nearest".
Parameter.GenerateHeader: States whether a header shall be automatically generated. Defaults to FALSE.
Parameter.Scroll: States whether the view shall be scrolled when the panel unfolds. Default is FALSE.
Parameter.ScrollToTop: States whether a round scroll-to-top button shall be displayed at the bottom-right of the unfolded panel. Possible values: "true" (always visible), "auto" (visible only when the panel's content is taller than 1.5x the viewport height), or "false" (hidden). Defaults to AUTO.
Parameter.Accordion: If set, this panel becomes part of an accordion. All panels sharing the same accordion name will be folded when one of them is unfolded.

Folded.description: States whether this panel is folded (TRUE) or unfolded (everything else) when it is loaded (defaults to TRUE).
Folded.descriptionDe: Gibt an, ob dieses Panel beim Laden eingeklappt (WAHR) oder aufgeklappt (alles andere) ist (Standard: WAHR).
Folded.descriptionIt: Indica se questo pannello è ripiegato (TRUE) o aperto (qualunque altro valore) quando viene caricato (predefinito: TRUE).

CSSHeaderHover.description: The optional header's CSS:hover (defaults to { scale : 1.1 ;}).
CSSHeaderHover.descriptionDe: Das optionale CSS:hover des Headers (Standard: { scale : 1.1 ;}).

CSSHeaderActive.description: The optional header's CSS:active (defaults to { scale : .9 ;}).
CSSHeaderActive.descriptionDe: Das optionale CSS:active des Headers (Standard: { scale : .9 ;}).

CSSHeaderFolded.description: The optional CSS to be applied onto the header when the panel is FOLDED. Without it a panel that is (or starts) folded would lose the header look set via CSSHeaderUnfolded.
CSSHeaderFolded.descriptionDe: Das optionale CSS, das auf den Header angewendet wird, wenn das Panel EINGEKLAPPT ist. Ohne dieses würde ein eingeklapptes (oder startend eingeklapptes) Panel das über CSSHeaderUnfolded gesetzte Header-Look verlieren.
CSSHeaderFolded.descriptionIt: Il CSS opzionale da applicare all'header quando il pannello è RIPIEGATO. Senza di esso, un pannello ripiegato (o che inizia ripiegato) perderebbe l'aspetto dell'header impostato tramite CSSHeaderUnfolded.

CSSHeaderUnfolded.description: The optional CSS to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded.
CSSHeaderUnfolded.descriptionDe: Das optionale CSS, das auf den Header angewendet wird, wenn das Panel aufgeklappt ist.
CSSHeaderUnfolded.descriptionIt: Il CSS opzionale da applicare all'header quando il pannello è aperto.

DCSSHeaderUnfolded.description: The optional Darkmode CSS to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded.
DCSSHeaderUnfolded.descriptionDe: Das optionale Darkmode-CSS, das auf den Header angewendet wird, wenn das Panel aufgeklappt ist.
DCSSHeaderUnfolded.descriptionIt: Il CSS Darkmode opzionale da applicare all'header quando il pannello è aperto.

CSSAnimFadeINPanel.description: The optional animation to be applied onto the panel whenever the panel is unfolded.
CSSAnimFadeINPanel.descriptionDe: Die optionale Animation, die auf das Panel angewendet wird, wenn das Panel aufgeklappt wird.
CSSAnimFadeINPanel.descriptionIt: L'animazione opzionale da applicare al pannello quando viene aperto.

CSSAnimFadeINPanelDuration.description: The optional animation's duration that is applied onto the panel whenever the panel is unfolded (defaults to 0s).
CSSAnimFadeINPanelDuration.descriptionDe: Die optionale Dauer der Animation, die auf das Panel angewendet wird, wenn das Panel aufgeklappt wird (Standard: 0s).
CSSAnimFadeINPanelDuration.descriptionIt: La durata opzionale dell'animazione applicata al pannello quando viene aperto (predefinito: 0s).

CSSAnimFadeINPanelEasing.description: The optional animation's easing function that is applied onto the panel whenever the panel is unfolded (defaults to "ease-in-out").
CSSAnimFadeINPanelEasing.descriptionDe: Die optionale Easing-Funktion der Animation, die auf das Panel angewendet wird, wenn das Panel aufgeklappt wird (Standard: "ease-in-out").
CSSAnimFadeINPanelEasing.descriptionIt: La funzione di easing opzionale dell'animazione applicata al pannello quando viene aperto (predefinito: "ease-in-out").

CSSAfterHeader.description: The CSS:after to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded.
CSSAfterHeader.descriptionDe: Das CSS:after, das auf den Header angewendet wird, wenn das Panel eingeklappt ist.
CSSAfterHeader.descriptionIt: Il CSS:after da applicare all'header quando il pannello è ripiegato.

CSSBeforeHeader.description: The CSS:before to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded (will be overwritten when required fields are contained by the panel).
CSSBeforeHeader.descriptionDe: Das CSS:before, das auf den Header angewendet wird, wenn das Panel eingeklappt ist (wird überschrieben, wenn Pflichtfelder im Panel enthalten sind).
CSSBeforeHeader.descriptionIt: Il CSS:before da applicare all'header quando il pannello è ripiegato (verrà sovrascritto quando il pannello contiene campi obbligatori).

CSSAfterHeaderContent.description: The CSS:after content to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded.
CSSAfterHeaderContent.descriptionDe: Der CSS:after-Inhalt, der auf den Header angewendet wird, wenn das Panel eingeklappt ist.
CSSAfterHeaderContent.descriptionIt: Il contenuto CSS:after da applicare all'header quando il pannello è ripiegato.

CSSBeforeHeaderContent.description: The CSS:before content to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded (will be overwritten when required fields are contained by the panel).
CSSBeforeHeaderContent.descriptionDe: Der CSS:before-Inhalt, der auf den Header angewendet wird, wenn das Panel eingeklappt ist (wird überschrieben, wenn Pflichtfelder im Panel enthalten sind).
CSSBeforeHeaderContent.descriptionIt: Il contenuto CSS:before da applicare all'header quando il pannello è ripiegato (verrà sovrascritto quando il pannello contiene campi obbligatori).

CSSAfterHeaderContentUnfolded.description: The CSS:after content to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded.
CSSAfterHeaderContentUnfolded.descriptionDe: Der CSS:after-Inhalt, der auf den Header angewendet wird, wenn das Panel aufgeklappt ist.
CSSAfterHeaderContentUnfolded.descriptionIt: Il contenuto CSS:after da applicare all'header quando il pannello è aperto.

CSSBeforeHeaderContentUnfolded.description: The CSS:after content to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded (will be overwritten when required fields are contained by the panel).
CSSBeforeHeaderContentUnfolded.descriptionDe: Der CSS:before-Inhalt, der auf den Header angewendet wird, wenn das Panel aufgeklappt ist (wird überschrieben, wenn Pflichtfelder im Panel enthalten sind).
CSSBeforeHeaderContentUnfolded.descriptionIt: Il contenuto CSS:before da applicare all'header quando il pannello è aperto (verrà sovrascritto quando il pannello contiene campi obbligatori).

CSSRequiredFieldsContent.description: The CSS:before content to be applied onto the header if it contains a validation sensitive field.
CSSRequiredFieldsContent.descriptionDe: Der CSS:before-Inhalt, der auf den Header angewendet wird, wenn er ein validierungssensitives Feld enthält.
CSSRequiredFieldsContent.descriptionIt: Il contenuto CSS:before da applicare all'header se contiene un campo sensibile alla validazione.

CSSRequiredFields.description: The CSS:before to be applied onto the header if it contains a validation sensitive field.
CSSRequiredFields.descriptionDe: Das CSS:before, das auf den Header angewendet wird, wenn er ein validierungssensitives Feld enthält.
CSSRequiredFields.descriptionIt: Il CSS:before da applicare all'header se contiene un campo sensibile alla validazione.

AutoHeaderTitle.description: The string the automatically generated header shall display.
AutoHeaderTitle.descriptionDe: Die Zeichenfolge, die der automatisch generierte Header anzeigen soll.
AutoHeaderTitle.descriptionIt: La stringa che l'header generato automaticamente deve visualizzare.

AutoHeaderTitleSupplementsSpacer.description: The string separating the actual title from the strings that're supplemented (values of inputs tagged with the CSS-Class CodBi_HTML_Panel_AutoHeaderTitle_Supplement). Encode surrounding spaces as %20 or \s.
AutoHeaderTitleSupplementsSpacer.descriptionDe: Die Zeichenfolge, die den tatsächlichen Titel von den ergänzten Zeichenfolgen trennt (Werte von Eingaben mit der CSS-Klasse CodBi_HTML_Panel_AutoHeaderTitle_Supplement). Umgebende Leerzeichen als %20 oder \s kodieren.
AutoHeaderTitleSupplementsSpacer.descriptionIt: La stringa che separa il titolo effettivo dalle stringhe supplementari (valori degli input marcati con la classe CSS CodBi_HTML_Panel_AutoHeaderTitle_Supplement). Codifica gli spazi circostanti come %20 o \s.

AutoHeaderLevel.description: Which level of enclosing heading the AutoHeaderTitle shall have, e.g. to get a h1 enclosure the value has to be 1.
AutoHeaderLevel.descriptionDe: Welche Ebene der umschließenden Überschrift der AutoHeaderTitle haben soll, z. B. muss der Wert 1 sein, um eine h1-Umhüllung zu erhalten.
AutoHeaderLevel.descriptionIt: Quale livello di intestazione circostante deve avere l'AutoHeaderTitle, es. per ottenere un contenitore h1 il valore deve essere 1.

ScrollBlock.description: Defines the logical position to scroll to when the panel is unfolded (start, center, end, nearest). Defaults to "nearest".
ScrollBlock.descriptionDe: Definiert die logische Position, zu der beim Aufklappen des Panels gescrollt wird (start, center, end, nearest). Standard: "nearest".
ScrollBlock.descriptionIt: Definisce la posizione logica a cui scorrere quando il pannello viene aperto (start, center, end, nearest). Predefinito: "nearest".

GenerateHeader.description: States whether a header shall be automatically generated. Defaults to FALSE.
GenerateHeader.descriptionDe: Gibt an, ob automatisch ein Header generiert werden soll. Standard: FALSCH.
GenerateHeader.descriptionIt: Indica se un'header deve essere generato automaticamente. Predefinito: FALSE.

Scroll.description: States whether the view shall be scrolled when the panel unfolds. Default is FALSE.
Scroll.descriptionDe: Gibt an, ob die Ansicht gescrollt werden soll, wenn sich das Panel aufklappt. Standard: FALSCH.
Scroll.descriptionIt: Indica se la vista deve essere scorsa quando il pannello si apre. Predefinito: FALSE.

ScrollToTop.description: States whether a round scroll-to-top button shall be displayed at the bottom-right of the unfolded panel. Possible values: "true" (always visible), "auto" (visible only when the panel's content is taller than 1.5x the viewport height), or "false" (hidden). Defaults to AUTO.
ScrollToTop.descriptionDe: Gibt an, ob eine runde Scroll-nach-oben-Schaltfläche unten rechts im aufgeklappten Panel angezeigt werden soll. Mögliche Werte: "true" (immer sichtbar), "auto" (nur sichtbar, wenn der Panelinhalt höher als das 1,5-fache der Viewport-Höhe ist) oder "false" (verborgen). Standard: AUTO.
ScrollToTop.descriptionIt: Indica se mostrare un pulsante circolare di scorrimento verso l'alto in basso a destra del pannello aperto. Valori possibili: "true" (sempre visibile), "auto" (visibile solo quando il contenuto del pannello è più alto di 1,5 volte l'altezza del viewport), o "false" (nascosto). Predefinito: AUTO.

Accordion.description: If set, this panel becomes part of an accordion. All panels sharing the same accordion name will be folded when one of them is unfolded.
Accordion.descriptionDe: Wenn gesetzt, wird dieses Panel Teil eines Akkordeons. Alle Panels mit demselben Akkordeonnamen werden eingeklappt, wenn eines davon aufgeklappt wird.
Accordion.descriptionIt: Se impostato, questo pannello diventa parte di un accordion. Tutti i pannelli con lo stesso nome accordion verranno ripiegati quando uno di essi viene aperto.
